title: 第六十三章 西洋狼人一招打爆第六十二章 老夫一生不负于人
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 所有的秘武高手，心态都崩了，哭喊惨叫，疯狂逃窜。
每个人都几乎魂飞魄散。
之前口口声声的救国、口口声声为了民族...
这一刻全都成为了虚妄。
所有人都恐惧无比，连滚带爬，恨不得有多远逃多远。
噩梦！
这是真正切切的噩梦！
那个老将杀人如麻！
之前的任何道德绑架都没有打动他。
成片成片的高手，就像是稻草一样在被收割。
原本拥挤的秘武高手，一下子就惨死了不知道多少。
地面上到处都是零碎的尸体、鲜血。
论摧毁一个人的意志有多快？
答：就是这么快！
只想牺牲他人的空谈报国，在面对真正的死亡时，往往是第一个崩溃的。
混乱的人群中。
四位隐藏在角落的人影，面色变幻，眼睁睁看着林玄在人群中杀戮，对视一眼，而后想也不想，转身便向着远处掠去。
但他们想在林玄眼皮地底下逃走，又怎么可能？
丹劲大宗师，精气神都已练到登堂入室！
尤其是林玄，精神力到达第四阶段【凝魄】，你看他一眼，他几乎就能千里锁魂。
当然，这个‘千里’是虚指。
但总体而言，就是你的视线不能蕴含任何的恨意、敌意、杀意等负面情绪在里面。
若不然但凡有一丝。
【凝魄境】的高手也能瞬间感应。
所以在那几道人影刚要离去。
林玄便是眼神一冷，骤然回头。
而后身躯化为一道残影，几乎瞬间追了过去。
砰砰砰！
上来有三道人影几乎被瞬间击中后背，狂吐血水，一身骨骼、内脏全部粉碎，眼睛暴突，狠狠前扑出去。
剩下那道人影露出惊恐，装备在小腿的腿铠猛然发力，蒸汽爆发，噔的一下，弹跳出去，如同炮弹一样，一下子弹出了数百米。
但林玄眼神一冷，几乎如影随形。
在对方刚刚弹出数百米，身躯便是嗖的一下，出现在了对方身后。
对方惊恐更浓，连忙再次弹跳。
林玄早已一记【金刚掌】发出。
劲力透体而出十几米。
砰的一声，结结实实打在对方身躯。
瘫软的尸体顿时狠狠砸在地上。
眼睛瞪大，口鼻溢血，很多内脏碎片都从嘴巴中涌了出来。
死的不能再死。
林玄眼神冰冷，刚要转身离去，但忽然脚步一顿。
四面八方一股无形的气势牢牢锁定住他的身躯。
好似层层阴影覆盖而来。
content_en:
All the secret martial arts masters were mentally shattered, crying and screaming, and ran away like crazy.
Everyone was almost out of their wits.
Before, we kept talking about saving the country and for the sake of the nation...
At this moment, everything became false.
Everyone was so frightened that they rolled and crawled, wanting to escape as far as possible.
Nightmare!
This is truly a nightmare!
That veteran kills people like crazy!
None of the previous moral kidnappings moved him.
Thousands of experts are being harvested like straw.
An unknown number of the originally crowded secret martial arts masters died tragically in one fell swoop.
There were scattered corpses and blood everywhere on the ground.
On how quickly a person’s will can be destroyed?
Answer: It’s that fast!
Empty talk about serving the country only at the expense of others is often the first to collapse when faced with real death.
In the chaotic crowd.
The expressions of the four figures hidden in the corner changed as they watched Lin Xuan kill in the crowd. They looked at each other, then turned around and swept away into the distance without thinking.
But how could they possibly escape under Lin Xuan's nose?
The great master of Danjin has mastered his energy, energy and spirit to the point where he can enter the palace!
Especially Lin Xuan, whose mental power has reached the fourth stage [Condensation]. If you look at him, he can almost lock his soul thousands of miles away.
Of course, this 'thousand miles' is an empty reference.
But generally speaking, your sight must not contain any negative emotions such as hatred, hostility, or murderous intent.
If not, there is only a trace of it.
Masters of [Condensation Realm] can also sense it instantly.
So those figures were just about to leave.
Lin Xuan's eyes turned cold and he turned back suddenly.
Then the body turned into an afterimage, and he chased after him almost instantly.
Bang bang bang!
Three figures came up and were hit in the back almost instantly, vomiting blood and water, their bones and internal organs were all shattered, their eyes popped out, and they threw themselves forward fiercely.
The remaining figure showed fear, and the leg armor equipped on the calf suddenly exerted force, steam exploded, and bounced out with a thud, like a cannonball, flying hundreds of meters in one go.
But Lin Xuan's eyes were cold, almost like a shadow.
Just after the opponent popped up a few hundred meters, his body suddenly appeared behind him.
The other party became even more frightened and quickly bounced again.
Lin Xuan had already sent out a [Vajra Palm].
The strength penetrated the body and spread out for more than ten meters.
With a bang, it hit the opponent's body firmly.
The limp body suddenly hit the ground hard.
His eyes were wide open, his mouth and nose were bleeding, and many internal organ fragments were pouring out of his mouth.
The dead can no longer die.
Lin Xuan's eyes were cold and he was about to turn around and leave, but suddenly his footsteps stopped.
An invisible aura from all directions firmly locked onto his body.
It's like being covered in layers of shadows.
